raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: fonttools
  version: "4.68.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/fonttools-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 73294e233070f71e2b3653b6bd8564af676d57f26d075761fb06d1ab2e4a7a5d

build:
  number: 1
  # pure-Python fallback (built on linux-64 only) for platforms/pythons without a compiled build
  noarch: ${{ "python" if use_noarch }}
  variant:
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if use_noarch else 0 }}
  script:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: export FONTTOOLS_WITH_CYTHON=0
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - fonttools = fontTools.__main__:main
      - ttx = fontTools.ttx:main
      - pyftsubset = fontTools.subset:main
      - pyftmerge = fontTools.merge:main

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not use_noarch
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - cython
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
      else: python
  run:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python >=${{ python_min }}
      else: python
    - brotli
    - munkres
    - if: use_noarch or match(python, "<=3.12")
      then: unicodedata2 >=15.1.0

tests:
  - if: use_noarch
    then:
      python:
        imports:
          - fontTools
          - fontTools.ttLib
          - fontTools.cffLib
        pip_check: true
        python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
    else:
      python:
        imports:
          - fontTools
          - fontTools.ttLib
          - fontTools.cffLib
        pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - if: use_noarch
          then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - fonttools --help
      - fonttools subset --help
      - ttx -h
      - pyftsubset --help
      # pyftmerge has no help option

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: fontTools is a library for manipulating fonts, written in Python.
  description: |
    fontTools is a library for manipulating fonts, written in Python. The
    project includes the TTX tool, that can convert TrueType and OpenType
    fonts to and from an XML text format, which is also called TTX. It
    supports TrueType, OpenType, AFM and to an extent Type 1 and some
    Mac-specific formats. The project has a BSD-style open-source licence.
  homepage: https://github.com/fonttools/fonttools
  repository: https://github.com/fonttools/fonttools
  documentation: https://fonttools.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - CJ-Wright
    - dopplershift
    - tacaswell
    - carlodri
